knot_definition: support-derived knots: upper bound of four-region common IQR and upper bound of four-region common 5-95% isolation support
model: grouped-binomial logit with cluster-robust covariance; selfing_core + area + climate adjusted; raw log(1+distance) slopes with support-derived hinge terms
interpretation: post-hoc exposure-nonlinearity diagnostic; not a causal pollinator test or submission inference
